answer: Voice liveness gate. Each identity files a 15 second clip: seeded words, six random syllables, one cough. Onsets must track prompt order, so pre-rendered files fail. Breath gaps and co-articulation, one sound bleeding into the next, must land on cue, the detail synthesizers flatten. The vocal tract spectrum hashes into a print; two identities inside one narrow band fold into one vote, so a farm cannot stack a hundred voices on that ledge. A thousand clones needs a thousand speakers, four thousand dollars an epoch. A cloned voice is a whisper at a wharf, carries far, loads nothing.
